note: A tune up the neck played faster, then from memory over a drone on its home note. The old tempo stages are now moves (80 to 100 bpm) and any key, so the text names the key and tempo as params; the last block ends with one change to make the tune your own.

exercise.title: The tune, faster and from memory
exercise.why: A tune you can play without the tab is one your ear is leading, so the drone replaces the screen and tells you when you are home.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the tune at {{=bpm}}, and play along from the tab.
Practice until the quick notes in the third bar come out even.

Press Play below to start the drone on {{=key}}, then look away from the tab. Play the tune from memory at your own pace, and listen for the last note blending into the drone.
Then change one thing: the rhythm of the third bar, or the octave you play it in.
{{?key}}In another key the tune starts on another fret and keeps its shape, and it still ends on the drone's note.
